items.title: 2 S&P 500 Stocks for Long-Term Investors and 1 Facing Challenges
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

items.title: CEO Switch At Omnicom Advertising As Robertson Succeeds Ruhanen
items.summary: Omnicom Advertising was announced in mid-2024 and took effect in January of 2025 as the company was making integration plans related to its IPG acquisition. It oversees the company's global ad networks including BBDO, which absorbed the operations of IPG's FCB.

items.title: SIRI Showered Owners With Cash. The Stock Still Lagged The Market
items.summary: The satellite radio giant sent owners a fortune in cash, yet the stock went backward over those five years (it has actually outpaced the market over the past year). Here is the accounting of what that trade actually delivered, and what has to go right from here.

items.title: PepsiCo hands global media to Publicis amid transformation at CPG giant
items.summary: Omnicom was the incumbent on the account, which is moving agencies as PepsiCo navigates changing consumer appetites and technology demands.

items.title: 1 Mid-Cap Stock for Long-Term Investors and 2 That Underwhelm
items.summary: Mid-cap stocks often strike the right balance between having proven business models and market opportunities that can support $100 billion corporations. However, they face intense competition from scaled industry giants and can be disrupted by new innovative players vying for a slice of the pie.

items.title: Omnicom Combines Mediahub, Hearts & Science
